require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'docker-api'
require 'securerandom'
require 'rack/session'

module ContainerOrchestrator
  class TokenStore
    def initialize
      @tokens = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def generate(session_id)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
        @tokens[session_id] = token
        token
      end
    end

    def validate(session_id, token)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        stored = @tokens[session_id]
        return false if stored.nil? || token.nil?
        timing_safe_compare(stored, token)
      end
    end

    private

    def timing_safe_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end

  class App < Sinatra::Base
    configure do
      enable :sessions
      set :session_secret, SecureRandom.hex(64)
      set :docker_pool, ConnectionPool.new(size: 5, timeout: 3) {
        Docker::Connection.new(ENV['DOCKER_HOST'] || 'unix:///var/run/docker.sock', {})
      }
      set :token_store, TokenStore.new
      set :protection, except: :session_hijacking
    end

    helpers do
      def current_user
        session[:user_id]
      end

      def authenticated?
        !current_user.nil?
      end

      def csrf_token
        settings.token_store.generate(session[:session_id] || session.id)
      end

      def verify_csrf!
        token = request.env['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] || params['csrf_token']
        session_key = session[:session_id] || session.id
        unless settings.token_store.validate(session_key, token)
          halt 403, { error: 'Invalid CSRF token' }.to_json
        end
      end

      def require_auth!
        halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless authenticated?
      end

      def mutating_request?
        !['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].include?(request.request_method)
      end

      def valid_bearer_token?(header)
        return false if header.nil?
        return false unless header.start_with?('Bearer ')
        token = header.sub('Bearer ', '')
        # Validate against pre-shared API keys stored securely
        api_keys = (ENV['API_KEYS'] || '').split(',')
        return false if api_keys.empty?
        api_keys.any? { |key| timing_safe_compare_public(token, key.strip) }
      end

      def timing_safe_compare_public(a, b)
        return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
        return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
        l = a.unpack('C*')
        r = b.unpack('C*')
        result = 0
        l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
        result == 0
      end
    end

    before do
      content_type :json
      if authenticated? && mutating_request?
        # Skip CSRF verification for API requests with valid Bearer token
        unless valid_bearer_token?(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
          verify_csrf!
        end
      end
    end

    post '/api/auth/login' do
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      configured_password = ENV['ADMIN_PASSWORD']
      supplied_password = data['password']
      # Require a configured password; use timing-safe comparison to avoid
      # credential timing attacks and prevent nil-vs-nil authentication bypass.
      valid_password =
        !configured_password.nil? &&
        !configured_password.empty? &&
        supplied_password.is_a?(String) &&
        timing_safe_compare_public(supplied_password, configured_password)
      if data['username'] == 'admin' && valid_password
        session[:user_id] = data['username']
        session[:session_id] = SecureRandom.hex(16)
        { success: true, csrf_token: csrf_token }.to_json
      else
        halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
      end
    end

    get '/api/containers' do
      require_auth!
      settings.docker_pool.with do |conn|
        containers = Docker::Container.all({}, conn)
        containers.map { |c| { id: c.id[0..11], name: c.info['Names']&.first, status: c.info['State'] } }.to_json
      end
    end

    post '/api/containers' do
      require_auth!
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      settings.docker_pool.with do |conn|
        container = Docker::Container.create({
          'Image' => data['image'],
          'Cmd' => data['cmd'],
          'name' => data['name'],
          'HostConfig' => { 'Memory' => 512_000_000, 'CpuShares' => 512 }
        }, conn)
        container.start
        { id: container.id[0..11], status: 'started' }.to_json
      end
    end

    delete '/api/containers/:id' do
      require_auth!
      settings.docker_pool.with do |conn|
        container = Docker::Container.get(params[:id], {}, conn)
        container.stop
        container.delete(force: true)
        { success: true }.to_json
      end
    end

    post '/api/containers/:id/exec' do
      require_auth!
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      settings.docker_pool.with do |conn|
        container = Docker::Container.get(params[:id], {}, conn)
        result = container.exec(data['cmd'].split(' '))
        { output: result[0], exit_code: result[2] }.to_json
      end
    end

    post '/api/scale' do
      require_auth!
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      image = data['image']
      count = [data['count'].to_i, 20].min
      results = []
      settings.docker_pool.with do |conn|
        count.times do |i|
          container = Docker::Container.create({
            'Image' => image,
            'name' => "scaled_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}_#{i}",
            'HostConfig' => { 'Memory' => 256_000_000, 'CpuShares' => 256 }
          }, conn)
          container.start
          results << { id: container.id[0..11], index: i }
        end
      end
      { scaled: results }.to_json
    end
  end
end
